title: A Model of Post‐2008 Monetary Policy
title_zh: 2008年后货币政策的一个模型
title_primary: 2008年后货币政策的一个模型
title_secondary: A Model of Post‐2008 Monetary Policy
authors: BEHZAD DIBA, OLIVIER LOISEL
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract: We introduce banks and bank reserves into the basic New Keynesian model and allow the central bank to set both the interest rate on reserves (IOR rate) and the nominal stock of reserves. Our model can account, in qualitative terms, for three key features of U.S. inflation during the recent zero‐lower‐bound (ZLB) episodes: no significant deflation, little inflation volatility, and no significant inflation following quantitative‐easing policies. Crucial to this result is our assumption that demand for bank reserves got close to satiation, but did not reach full satiation. We introduce liquid government bonds into the model to reconcile our nonsatiation assumption with the fact that Treasury‐bill rates were often below the IOR rate during the ZLB episodes. Looking ahead, we explore the implications of our model for the normalization of monetary policy and its operational framework (floor system).
abstract_zh: 我们将银行和银行准备金引入基础新凯恩斯模型，并允许中央银行同时设定准备金利率（IOR利率）和名义准备金存量。我们的模型在定性上能够解释近期零利率下限（ZLB）期间美国通胀的三个关键特征：无显著通缩、通胀波动性低，以及量化宽松政策后未出现显著通胀。这一结果的关键在于我们的假设：银行准备金需求接近饱和，但未完全饱和。我们将流动性政府债券引入模型，以调和我们的非饱和假设与ZLB期间国库券利率通常低于IOR利率这一事实。展望未来，我们探讨了该模型对货币政策正常化及其操作框架（地板系统）的启示。

title: Government Policies in a Granular Global Economy
title_zh: 颗粒化全球经济中的政府政策
title_primary: 颗粒化全球经济中的政府政策
title_secondary: Government Policies in a Granular Global Economy
authors: Cecile Gaubert, Oleg Itskhoki, Maximilian Vogler
official: 官方在线 2021-03-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We use the granular model of international trade developed in Gaubert and Itskhoki (2021) to study the rationale and implications of three types of government interventions typically targeted at large individual firms - antitrust, trade and industrial policies. We find that in antitrust regulation, governments face an incentive to be overly lenient in accepting mergers of large domestic firms, which acts akin to beggar-thy-neighbor trade policy in sectors with strong comparative advantage. In trade policy, targeting large individual foreign exporters rather than entire sectors is desirable from the point of view of a national government. Doing so minimizes the pass-through of import tariffs into domestic consumer prices, placing a greater portion of the burden on foreign producers. Finally, we show that subsidizing `national champions' is generally suboptimal in closed economies as it leads to an excessive build-up of market power, but it may become unilaterally welfare improving in open economies. We contrast unilaterally optimal policies with the coordinated global optimal policy and emphasize the need for international policy cooperation in these domains.
abstract_zh: 我们运用Gaubert和Itskhoki（2021）提出的国际贸易颗粒模型，研究了三类通常针对大型个体企业的政府干预措施——反垄断、贸易和产业政策——的理论依据及其影响。研究发现，在反垄断监管中，政府倾向于对大型国内企业的合并过于宽容，这类似于在具有较强比较优势的行业中实施以邻为壑的贸易政策。在贸易政策方面，从国家政府的角度来看，针对大型外国出口企业而非整个行业更为可取。这样做能最小化进口关税向国内消费者价格的传导，将更大比例的负担转嫁给外国生产者。最后，我们表明，在封闭经济中补贴“国家冠军”企业通常并非最优选择，因为这会导致市场力量的过度积累，但在开放经济中，这种补贴可能单方面提升福利。我们将单方面最优政策与协调的全球最优政策进行对比，并强调在这些领域进行国际政策合作的必要性。

title: Safety net payment digitization and participant outcomes: Evidence from the WIC EBT transition
title_zh: 安全网支付数字化与参与者结果：来自WIC EBT转型的证据
title_primary: 安全网支付数字化与参与者结果：来自WIC EBT转型的证据
title_secondary: Safety net payment digitization and participant outcomes: Evidence from the WIC EBT transition
authors: Charlotte Ambrozek, Timothy K.M. Beatty, Wenjie Zhan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Can digital technologies improve the efficiency of social safety net programs? This paper examines the impact of digitizing payments in the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) on participant outcomes. We hand-collect the rollout schedule of payment digitization and link it to WIC participation and birth outcomes across multiple datasets. We find that WIC participation increases and birth outcomes improve among mothers exposed to digitization. Suggestive evidence indicates that payment digitization raises WIC participation by increasing awareness of the program and reducing stigma at the point of purchase, and that higher participation may, in turn, improve birth outcomes by increasing health insurance enrollment. Our back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that payment digitization is fiscally appealing, with a marginal value of public funds of 0.94. These findings can inform evaluations of further digitization in safety net programs, such as online redemption.
abstract_zh: 数字技术能否提升社会安全网项目的效率？本文考察了妇女、婴儿及儿童特别补充营养计划（WIC）中支付数字化的影响及其对参与者结果的作用。我们手工收集了支付数字化的推广时间表，并将其与多个数据集中的WIC参与情况及出生结果相关联。研究发现，接触数字化的母亲中，WIC参与率上升，出生结果得到改善。初步证据表明，支付数字化通过提高项目认知度和减少购买时的污名效应来增加WIC参与，而更高的参与率可能进而通过增加健康保险注册来改善出生结果。我们的粗略估算显示，支付数字化在财政上具有吸引力，公共资金的边际价值为0.94。这些发现可为评估安全网项目中进一步数字化（如在线兑换）提供参考。

title: Union Leaders: Experimental Evidence from Myanmar
title_zh: 工会领袖：来自缅甸的实验证据
title_primary: 工会领袖：来自缅甸的实验证据
title_secondary: Union Leaders: Experimental Evidence from Myanmar
authors: Laura Boudreau, Rocco Macchiavello, Virginia Minni, Mari Tanaka
official: 官方在线 2023-06-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Social movements are catalysts for crucial institutional changes. To succeed, they must coordinate members’ views (consensus building) and actions (mobilization). We study union leaders within Myanmar’s burgeoning labor movement. Union leaders are positively selected on both personality traits that enable them to influence others and ability but earn lower wages. In group discussions about workers’ views on an upcoming national minimum wage negotiation, randomly embedded leaders build consensus around the union’s preferred policy. In an experiment that mimics individual decision-making in a collective action set-up, leaders increase mobilization through coordination. Leaders empower social movements by building consensus that encourages mobilization.
abstract_zh: 社会运动是推动关键制度变革的催化剂。为了成功，它们必须协调成员的观点（共识构建）与行动（动员）。我们研究了缅甸蓬勃发展的劳工运动中的工会领袖。工会领袖在个性特质上具有正向选择性，这些特质使他们能够影响他人，同时他们也具备较高的能力，但薪资却较低。在关于工人对即将到来的全国最低工资谈判看法的团体讨论中，随机嵌入的领袖围绕工会偏好的政策构建共识。在一个模拟集体行动情境中个体决策的实验中，领袖通过协调增强了动员。领袖通过构建鼓励动员的共识来赋能社会运动。

title: Rushing to the altar? Same-sex marriages when rights feel at risk
title_zh: 匆忙走向祭坛？当权利感到受威胁时的同性婚姻
title_primary: 匆忙走向祭坛？当权利感到受威胁时的同性婚姻
title_secondary: Rushing to the altar? Same-sex marriages when rights feel at risk
authors: Maciel, Mateus, Parente, Sara, Zuchowski, David
official: 官方在线 2026-08-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The literature on same-sex marriage has primarily focused on the effects of legal recognition, overlooking other factors that influence marriage decisions among same-sex couples. This study provides novel evidence on the role of political context by analyzing how the election of a homophobic leader affects these decisions. Using the case of Brazil, we examine the effect of revealed local support for the openly homophobic Jair Bolsonaro in the presidential elections on same-sex marriage dynamics. To estimate this effect, we apply a difference-in-differences approach with varying treatment intensity. The results show a significant increase in same-sex marriages in municipalities with higher support for Bolsonaro during the period between the election and the beginning of his presidential term. These findings suggest that perceived threats of rights restrictions can trigger immediate and significant personal decisions among minority groups, even in the absence of legal changes.
abstract_zh: 关于同性婚姻的文献主要聚焦于法律承认的影响，忽视了影响同性伴侣婚姻决定的其他因素。本研究通过分析仇视同性恋领导人的当选如何影响这些决定，提供了关于政治背景作用的新证据。以巴西为例，我们考察了公开仇视同性恋的雅伊尔·博索纳罗在总统选举中显露的地方支持度对同性婚姻动态的影响。为估计这一效应，我们采用了处理强度变化的双重差分方法。结果显示，在选举至其总统任期开始期间，博索纳罗支持度较高的城市中同性婚姻显著增加。这些发现表明，即使没有法律变动，权利受限的感知威胁也能触发少数群体即时且重大的个人决定。

title: Information Transparency of Firm Financing
title_zh: 企业融资信息透明度
title_primary: 企业融资信息透明度
title_secondary: Information Transparency of Firm Financing
authors: ANTOINE L. NOËL, HONGFEI SUN
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract: We propose a theory on information transparency of optimal financial contracts. Our model nests adverse selection and agency cost. There exists a unique perfect Bayesian equilibrium with novel features: First, three types of optimal contracts can arise endogenously, that is, equity, transparent debt, and opaque debt. The former two require firms to take on a costly verification technology while opaque debt does not. Second, the unique equilibrium is either pooling on opaque debt, or mixing with transparent and opaque financing. Third, firms with sufficiently high quality and intermediate levels of internal funds find it optimal to use a transparent contract.
abstract_zh: 我们提出关于最优金融合约信息透明度的理论。该模型嵌套了逆向选择与代理成本。存在一个具有新颖特征的唯一完美贝叶斯均衡：首先，三种类型的最优合约可内生产生，即股权、透明债务与不透明债务。前两者要求企业采用成本高昂的验证技术，而不透明债务则无需如此。其次，该唯一均衡要么是全部采用不透明债务的混同均衡，要么是透明融资与不透明融资混合的均衡。第三，具有足够高质量和中等内部资金水平的企业发现使用透明合约是最优选择。

title: The regional economic impact of weather shocks: Evidence from Portugal
title_zh: 天气冲击的区域经济影响：来自葡萄牙的证据
title_primary: 天气冲击的区域经济影响：来自葡萄牙的证据
title_secondary: The regional economic impact of weather shocks: Evidence from Portugal
authors: Drabindra Pandit, Paulo Rodrigues, João Seixo
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Weather extremes shape short-run economic activity through both market and nonmarket channels, yet evidence on local consumer-side activity remains limited. Using a municipality-level panel of Portuguese data (2010–2021), we estimate panel VAR and local-projection responses to weather shocks of point-of-sale purchases (a measure of merchant-location transaction activity, not resident household consumption), together with unemployment and house prices. Our central methodological finding is that hourly rather than daily measurement of rainfall variability raises the estimated semi-elasticities by an order of magnitude, suggesting that the existing climate-economy literature systematically understates the importance of high-intensity rainfall. Substantively, the local-projection responses indicate that hourly rainfall volatility raises purchases on impact and reverses the following quarter, consistent with intertemporal reallocation; temperature variability generates a sharp positive impact effect followed by a contraction; and high fire-danger days raise contemporaneous purchases. Unemployment and house prices follow the same patterns more weakly. Regional heterogeneity is substantial, the Lisbon Metropolitan Area and the Algarve sometimes display effects opposite in sign to those in the North.
abstract_zh: 极端天气通过市场与非市场渠道影响短期经济活动，但关于本地消费者侧活动的证据仍然有限。基于葡萄牙市级面板数据（2010-2021年），我们采用面板VAR和局部投影法估计了天气冲击对销售点购买行为（衡量商户所在地交易活动，而非居民家庭消费）、失业率和房价的影响。核心方法论发现是：以小时而非日度频率测量降雨变异性，会使估计的半弹性系数提升一个数量级，表明现有气候经济学文献系统性低估了高强度降雨的重要性。从实质结果看，局部投影响应显示：小时降雨波动性在当期推高购买量，随后一个季度出现反转，符合跨期重新配置特征；温度波动性产生先急剧正向冲击后收缩的效应；高火灾风险日则提升同期购买量。失业率和房价呈现相同但更弱的模式。区域异质性显著，里斯本大都市区和阿尔加维地区有时呈现与北部地区符号相反的效应。

abstract_zh: 失业期间动机的减弱可能导致求职成功率下降。我们报告了一项低成本数字干预措施的研究结果，该措施通过发送激励性电子邮件来提升求职者的积极性。

title: Talent Hoarding in Organizations
title_zh: 组织中的人才囤积现象
title_primary: 组织中的人才囤积现象
title_secondary: Talent Hoarding in Organizations
authors: Haegele, Ingrid
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Most organizations rely on managers to identify talented workers. However, managers who are evaluated on team performance have an incentive to hoard workers. This study provides the first empirical evidence of talent hoarding using personnel records and survey evidence from a large firm. Talent hoarding is self-reported by three-fourths of managers, is detectable in manager ratings of worker talent, and occurs more frequently under stronger hoarding incentives, proxied by performance-related pay, team size, and talent visibility. Using quasi-random exposure to talent hoarding, I show that hoarding deters internal job applications, inhibiting career progression and altering talent allocation in the firm.
abstract_zh: 大多数组织依赖管理者识别有才能的员工。然而，那些以团队绩效为考核标准的管理者，有动机囤积人才。本研究首次利用一家大型企业的人事档案和调查证据，提供了人才囤积的实证依据。四分之三的管理者自报存在人才囤积行为，这一现象在管理者对员工才能的评分中可被察觉，并且在囤积动机更强时（以绩效薪酬、团队规模和人才可见度为衡量指标）更为频繁。通过准随机暴露于人才囤积情境，本研究表明，囤积行为会抑制内部工作申请，阻碍职业发展，并改变企业内的人才配置。

title: How Does Monetary and Fiscal Policy Affect the Economy in the Face of Large Shocks?
title_zh: 货币与财政政策如何应对大规模冲击下的经济影响？
title_primary: 货币与财政政策如何应对大规模冲击下的经济影响？
title_secondary: How Does Monetary and Fiscal Policy Affect the Economy in the Face of Large Shocks?
authors: Greg Kaplan, Ken Miyahara
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We build a model that combines (i) heterogeneous households with incomplete markets, and (ii) state-dependent pricing with strategic complementarities by firms, to analyze the effects of large macroeconomic shocks and policy interventions. Both features significantly influence the transmission of fiscal stimulus and monetary policy—heterogeneous households because of failures of Ricardian equivalence, and state-dependent pricing because of its nonlinear effects on inflation. We use our model to quantify how monetary and fiscal policy shaped macroeconomic dynamics in response to the large shocks of 2020, and how alternative policy choices could have led to different aggregate and distributional outcomes. We find large departures from Ricardian equivalence and strong stepping-on-a-rake effects of interest rate changes. The large unfunded fiscal transfer program helped prevent deflation in 2020 and significantly raised output throughout 2021 and 2022, but led to permanently higher prices. The monetary easing through 2020 and 2021 also contributed to preventing deflation, but had a minimal impact on GDP. The monetary tightening from 2022 lowered the maximum inflation rate, but contributed to persistently above-trend inflation. These policies led to net welfare gains for low-wealth households and net welfare losses for high-wealth households, but those welfare effects are due to incomplete markets for idiosyncratic risk not aggregate stabilization. Alternative commitments to funding fiscal stimulus could have achieved similar short-term effects on inflation and output with a much smaller long-term increase in the price level.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个结合（i）异质性家庭与不完全市场，以及（ii）企业具有战略互补性的状态依存定价的模型，以分析大规模宏观经济冲击与政策干预的影响。这两个特征均显著影响财政刺激与货币政策的传导机制——异质性家庭因李嘉图等价失效，而状态依存定价则因其对通胀的非线性效应。我们利用该模型量化了2020年大规模冲击下货币与财政政策如何塑造宏观经济动态，并探讨了替代性政策选择可能导致的总体与分配结果差异。研究发现，李嘉图等价存在显著偏离，且利率变动具有强烈的“踩耙子效应”。大规模无资金支持的财政转移计划虽有助于防止2020年通缩，并在2021至2022年间显著提升产出，但导致价格永久性上升。2020至2021年的货币宽松政策同样有助于防止通缩，但对GDP影响甚微。2022年起的货币紧缩政策降低了通胀峰值，却导致通胀持续高于趋势水平。这些政策使低财富家庭获得净福利收益，而高财富家庭则承受净福利损失，但此类福利效应源于异质性风险的不完全市场，而非总需求稳定。若采用替代性财政刺激资金承诺，可在实现类似短期通胀与产出效果的同时，大幅降低长期价格水平的上升幅度。

title: Turnout and the distortion of representation: the case of electoral polarization
title_zh: 投票率与代表性扭曲：选举极化的案例
title_primary: 投票率与代表性扭曲：选举极化的案例
title_secondary: Turnout and the distortion of representation: the case of electoral polarization
authors: Alan Al Yussef
abstract: This paper examines the relationship between voter turnout and elec0737toral polarization. While much of the existing literature focuses on how polarization affects turnout, we analyze the next step in the causal chain: how turnout shapes electoral outcomes. We propose a simple theoretical model in which turnout depends on voters’ aversion to the expected governing coalition, which increases with the distance between the voter’s ideal point and the anticipated policy platform. This generates heterogeneous participation across the ideological spectrum, leading to a compositional reweighting of the electorate. When the governing coalition is expected to be centrist, centrist voters are underrepresented while voters at the ideological extremes are overrepresented, resulting in higher levels of observed electoral polarization. We test the theoretical predictions empirically, using municipality-level data from Dutch general elections. The results show that turnout has systematically heterogeneous effects across parties depending on their ideological position, with more extreme parties benefiting disproportionately from lower turnout. Consistent with the theory, lower turnout is associated with higher levels of electoral polarization. These findings highlight a compositional mechanism through which turnout influences electoral outcomes, resulting in a distorted picture in which electoral polarization exceeds what would be implied by the underlying distribution of ideological preferences in the population.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了选民投票率与选举极化之间的关系。现有文献多聚焦于极化如何影响投票率，而我们则分析因果链条中的下一步：投票率如何塑造选举结果。我们提出了一个简洁的理论模型，其中投票率取决于选民对预期执政联盟的反感程度，这种反感随选民理想点与预期政策立场之间的距离增加而增强。这导致意识形态光谱上的参与不均，进而引起选民构成上的重新加权。当预期执政联盟趋于中间派时，中间派选民的代表性不足，而意识形态极端选民则过度代表，从而使得观察到的选举极化水平升高。我们利用荷兰大选的市级数据对理论预测进行了实证检验。结果显示，投票率对不同政党具有系统性异质性影响，取决于其意识形态立场，极端政党在低投票率下获益不成比例。与理论一致，较低的投票率与较高的选举极化水平相关联。这些发现揭示了一种构成性机制，通过该机制投票率影响选举结果，导致选举极化超过人口中潜在意识形态偏好分布所隐含水平的扭曲景象。

abstract: Exchange rate movements have implications for the purchasing power of residents or voters. Given that the exchange rate is often seen as a barometer of government performance, there could be strong incentives to influence exchange rate valuation during elections. This paper investigates whether political economy factors affect Foreign Exchange Intervention (FXI) policy across countries. It investigates whether central banks tend to implement FX sales, leaning against depreciations, during electoral periods in a sample of 28 countries including both advanced (AEs) and emerging (EMs) economies over the period 2000-2019. The results show that EMs with competitive elections tend to implement more and larger FX sales in pre-electoral period, compared to post-election period, given their political popularity. Further, this result is driven by countries where political pressures on central bank governors are more prevalent. Furthermore, the paper also finds that monetary policy transparency has the potential to mitigate this politically driven FXI during electoral period. Finally, the paper discusses policy implications given that politically motivated FX sales could hamper the ability of central banks to effectively respond to large shocks.
abstract_zh: 汇率变动对居民或选民的购买力具有重要影响。鉴于汇率常被视为政府绩效的晴雨表，选举期间可能存在强烈动机干预汇率估值。本文研究政治经济因素是否会影响各国的外汇干预政策，基于2000-2019年涵盖28个经济体（包括发达经济体和新兴经济体）的样本，考察央行是否倾向于在选举期间实施外汇抛售以应对本币贬值压力。结果表明，具有竞争性选举的新兴经济体在选举前阶段，出于政治声望考量，会实施更多且规模更大的外汇抛售。进一步分析显示，这一结果在央行行长面临更普遍政治压力的国家尤为显著。此外，本文还发现货币政策透明度具有缓解选举期间政治驱动型外汇干预的潜力。最后，本文讨论了政策启示：出于政治动机的外汇抛售可能削弱央行有效应对重大冲击的能力。

title: Long-term Effects of US Tariff Increases on CAPDR

abstract: In a series of declarations throughout 2025 and into 2026, the United States announced higher tariffs on nearly all imports from most countries. The countries that make up the CAPDR region (Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama and El Salvador) are affected through sizeable direct trade linkages with the United States, and through indirect trade linkages with third countries. This paper explores the potential long-term economic effects of these tariff increases on CAPDR using a multi-region multi-industry model of the global economy. The modelling exercises suggest that CAPDR member countries will experience falls in real GDP to varying degrees, with the severity of the effect closely linked to direct export exposure to the United States. The most vulnerable industries are heavily trade-exposed manufactures, although exemptions – most importantly for textiles & apparel – may provide some scope for trade diversion to offset some of the GDP losses. Although ongoing legal challenges have introduced additional uncertainty regarding the ultimate extent of tariff changes, the results in this paper will remain broadly valid providing the tariffs remain in place.
abstract_zh: 在2025年至2026年的一系列声明中，美国宣布对来自大多数国家的几乎所有进口商品加征更高关税。中美洲-多米尼加共和国地区（CAPDR）成员国（哥斯达黎加、多米尼加共和国、危地马拉、洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜、巴拿马和萨尔瓦多）通过与美国直接且规模可观的贸易联系，以及与第三国的间接贸易联系而受到影响。本文运用全球经济多区域多产业模型，探讨了这些关税上调对CAPDR的潜在长期经济影响。模型测算表明，CAPDR成员国实际GDP将出现不同程度的下降，其影响严重程度与对美国的直接出口敞口密切相关。最脆弱的行业是高度依赖贸易的制造业，尽管豁免条款——最重要的是纺织品与服装——可能通过贸易转移在一定程度上抵消部分GDP损失。尽管持续的法律挑战为关税变动的最终幅度增添了额外不确定性，但只要关税措施持续实施，本文的研究结果将基本保持有效。

title: Asian immigrants, school quality, and the U.S. housing market
title_zh: 亚洲移民、学校质量与美国住房市场

title_secondary: Asian immigrants, school quality, and the U.S. housing market
authors: Amanda Ang, Eunjee Kwon, Siqi Zheng
abstract: This paper investigates how Asian immigrants affect U.S. housing prices and identifies the mechanisms underlying these effects. Using annual county-level data from 2009 to 2018 and a dual instrumental variable approach, we decompose the overall impact of Asian immigrants into education-related and non-education channels. We find that roughly 30%–40% of the housing price increase associated with Asian immigration is driven by the capitalization of improved educational amenities, while the remaining 60%–70% reflects non-education forces, such as home-biased foreign capital inflows and other neighborhood changes. The education-related capitalization effects are greater in counties with a higher share of Asian school-aged children, underscoring the key insight that immigrant composition — specifically, who arrives — matters for how immigration shapes local housing markets.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了亚洲移民如何影响美国房价，并识别了其背后的作用机制。利用2009年至2018年的县级年度数据及双重工具变量方法，我们将亚洲移民的整体影响分解为与教育相关及非教育渠道。研究发现，亚洲移民带来的房价上涨中，约30%至40%归因于教育设施改善的资本化效应，而其余60%至70%则反映了非教育因素，如本土偏好的外国资本流入及其他社区变化。教育相关的资本化效应在亚洲学龄儿童占比更高的县更为显著，这凸显了一个关键见解：移民构成——具体而言，即谁到来——对移民如何塑造地方住房市场至关重要。

title: Interplay of crop diversity and agricultural area in agroecosystem services: Analytical and empirical study on local water quality
title_zh: 作物多样性与农业面积在农业生态系统服务中的相互作用：基于地方水质的分析与实证研究
title_primary: 作物多样性与农业面积在农业生态系统服务中的相互作用：基于地方水质的分析与实证研究
title_secondary: Interplay of crop diversity and agricultural area in agroecosystem services: Analytical and empirical study on local water quality
authors: Yunsun Park, Seong D. Yun, Matthew G. Interis, T. Edward Yu
abstract: This study expands the framework for analyzing the interplay of agricultural area and crop diversity on agroecosystem services by incorporating the species‐area relationship concept from biology. We estimate panel fixed effects models that include both agricultural area and crop diversity, along with their interaction term. This approach allows us to derive a crop diversity threshold‐the point at which agricultural land no longer exerts a negative marginal effect on water quality, driven by adjustments along the intensive margin rather than the extensive margin. By replicating well‐established water quality models from the literature and conducting robustness checks, we validate this framework. Our results empirically demonstrate that crop diversity can mitigate the adverse impact of agricultural land on water quality, aligning with the goals of conservation programs. This framework provides a more comprehensive understanding of agriculture's non‐unidirectional contributions to water quality, rather than only negative impacts, which are pervasive in the literature. Moreover, the thresholds identified in this study provide valuable insights for prioritizing regions for landscape‐based, crop diversity‐driven conservation strategies and policy design.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过引入生物学中的物种-面积关系概念，拓展了分析农业面积与作物多样性对农业生态系统服务交互作用的框架。我们估计了包含农业面积、作物多样性及其交互项的面板固定效应模型。这一方法使我们能够推导出作物多样性阈值——即农业用地通过集约边际调整而非粗放边际调整，不再对水质产生负面边际效应的临界点。通过复现文献中成熟的水质模型并进行稳健性检验，我们验证了这一框架的有效性。实证结果表明，作物多样性能够缓解农业用地对水质的负面影响，这与保护项目的目标一致。该框架有助于更全面地理解农业对水质的非单向贡献（而非文献中普遍强调的单一负面影响）。此外，本研究识别的阈值可为优先区域划定提供依据，助力基于景观格局、以作物多样性为导向的保护策略与政策设计。

title: Socioeconomic Inequalities in Birth Weight: Novel Distributional Evidence from Linked Population Data

title_secondary: Socioeconomic Inequalities in Birth Weight: Novel Distributional Evidence from Linked Population Data
authors: Ha Trong Nguyen
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study is the first to use population-wide birth registration data spanning 18 years, linked to Census records, to examine the relationship between a comprehensive set of socioeconomic factors and the birth weight of more than 1.2 million children in Australia, both at the mean and across the distribution. Employing some of the most rigorous empirical approaches in the literature, including mother fixed-effects models, the study reports five main findings, several of which offer new insights for the literature. First, both maternal and paternal education are positively associated with children's birth weight, with stronger associations observed for maternal education and at the lower end of the birth weight distribution. Second, parental income exhibits a positive but non-linear association with birth weight, with larger effects among lower-birth-weight children. Third, relative to children living in rental housing, those born into families with mortgaged homes have higher average birth weights, whereas those born into families that own their homes outright have lower average birth weights. However, children from home-owning families exhibit higher birth weights at the lower end of the distribution but lower birth weights at the upper end. Fourth, more favourable local socioeconomic conditions are positively but non-linearly associated with birth weight, with stronger associations at the lower end of the distribution. Fifth, children born to mothers who migrated from low- or middle-income countries have lower birth weights than those born to mothers from high-income countries.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次利用覆盖18年的人口出生登记数据，并结合人口普查记录，考察了澳大利亚超过120万儿童出生体重与一系列社会经济因素在均值及分布层面的关联。通过采用文献中最严谨的实证方法（包括母亲固定效应模型），研究得出五项主要发现，其中多项为现有文献提供了新见解。第一，母亲与父亲的教育水平均与儿童出生体重呈正相关，其中母亲教育的关联性更强，且在出生体重分布的低端更为显著。第二，父母收入与出生体重呈正向但非线性的关联，对低出生体重儿童的影响更大。第三，相较于居住在租赁住房中的儿童，出生于有抵押贷款家庭的儿童平均出生体重更高，而出生于完全自有住房家庭的儿童平均出生体重更低。然而，来自完全自有住房家庭的儿童在出生体重分布低端呈现更高体重，但在高端则呈现更低体重。第四，更有利的本地社会经济条件与出生体重呈正向但非线性的关联，且在分布低端关联性更强。第五，出生于来自中低收入国家母亲的儿童，其出生体重低于出生于来自高收入国家母亲的儿童。

title: Ex-ante moral hazard? Overweight and health insurance expansion in Mexico
title_zh: 事前道德风险？墨西哥的超重与健康保险扩展
title_primary: 事前道德风险？墨西哥的超重与健康保险扩展
title_secondary: Ex-ante moral hazard? Overweight and health insurance expansion in Mexico
authors: Costa-Font, Joan, Györi, Mario, Saenz De Miera, Belen
official: 官方在线 2026-06-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Extending health insurance coverage to previously uninsured populations can improve access to preventive services by relaxing financial barriers to health information and care, including those related to weight management. However, in the presence of ex-ante moral hazard, insurance coverage may weaken incentives for preventive effort, potentially increasing unhealthy behaviours. This paper examines this phenomenon using evidence from the introduction of a universal public insurance program, namely Mexico’s Seguro Popular (SP), in the 2000s. We exploit plausibly exogenous variation in the rollout of SP across municipalities generated by differential implementation speeds. We find no evidence that the rollout of SP modified individuals’ body mass index (BMI) or obesity status. Further, heterogeneity analysis suggests that SP exposure leads to a significant reduction in BMI among individuals who were already overweight at baseline, and a 2 percentage point decline in smoking prevalence, consistent with the hypothesis that SP increased access to preventative health information. These results suggest no evidence of ex-ante moral hazard in weight-related health behaviours after the expansion of universal insurance.
abstract_zh: 将医疗保险覆盖范围扩展至此前未参保人群，可通过减轻获取健康信息与医疗服务（包括体重管理相关服务）的经济障碍，提升预防性服务的可及性。然而，在存在事前道德风险的情况下，保险覆盖可能削弱个体采取预防性行为的激励，从而增加不健康行为。本文利用21世纪初墨西哥实施全民公共医疗保险计划（即大众保险）的证据，研究这一现象。我们借助各城市因执行速度差异导致的大众保险推广进程中的外生变异，发现该保险推广并未改变个体的身体质量指数或肥胖状况。进一步异质性分析表明，大众保险的覆盖导致基线超重人群的身体质量指数显著下降，并使吸烟率降低2个百分点，这与保险覆盖增加了预防性健康信息可及性的假说一致。这些结果表明，在全民保险扩展后，体重相关健康行为中并未出现事前道德风险的证据。

title: Land sparing and sharing: Understanding the relationship between different construction land strategies and land functions in karst areas
title_zh: 土地节约与共享：理解喀斯特地区不同建设用地策略与土地功能之间的关系
title_primary: 土地节约与共享：理解喀斯特地区不同建设用地策略与土地功能之间的关系
title_secondary: Land sparing and sharing: Understanding the relationship between different construction land strategies and land functions in karst areas
authors: Lei Kang, Erqi Xu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land multifunctionality requires integrated strategies to reconcile diverse human needs within finite resources. Conventional land sparing and sharing (LSS) frameworks, primarily applied to agricultural trade-offs between food production and biodiversity, inadequately address the non-agricultural production and living functions associated with construction land development. This study extends the LSS framework to holistically assess production, living, and ecological functions under construction land intensification. Focusing on China's karst region, we employed the Development Intensity Index (DII) as a quantitative strategy indicator. Using sub-basins in the Southwest China karst belt as analytical units over 2010–2019, we integrated land function measurements with the DII, nonparametric tests, Locally Weighted Scatterplot Smoothing (LOWESS), and Bayesian Change Point (BCP) analysis to precisely delineate spatial strategy differentiation and nonlinear functional responses. Significant nonlinear relationships and critical threshold effects were revealed between land use strategies and functions. As DII increased, production function exhibited an inverted U-shaped trend, peaking at a DII of 6.2 then declining significantly. Living function maintained a continuous positive correlation, with its growth rate accelerating slightly beyond an intensity of 10.5. Ecology function remained negatively correlated, declining sharply at a DII of 0.65 followed by a slower decrease rate. The comprehensive land function index reaches an inflection point at a DII of 6.35, beyond which its growth rate diminishes until eventually turning negative. The research quantifies key functional response thresholds, broadens the LSS framework's applicability to multifunctional land systems encompassing construction land. This finding facilitates the scientific selection of land-use strategies and promotes the transition of territorial spatial development toward coordination and sustainability.
abstract_zh: 土地多功能性要求采取综合策略，在有限资源内协调多样化的人类需求。传统的土地节约与共享（LSS）框架主要应用于农业生产与生物多样性之间的权衡，未能充分涵盖与建设用地开发相关的非农业生产及生活功能。本研究将LSS框架拓展至建设用地集约化背景下生产、生活与生态功能的综合评估。以中国喀斯特地区为研究对象，采用发展强度指数（DII）作为定量化策略指标。以2010—2019年西南喀斯特带子流域为分析单元，将土地功能测度与DII、非参数检验、局部加权散点平滑（LOWESS）及贝叶斯变点（BCP）分析相结合，精确刻画空间策略分异及非线性功能响应。研究揭示了土地利用策略与功能之间显著的非线性关系及关键阈值效应。随着DII增加，生产功能呈倒U型趋势，在DII为6.2时达到峰值后显著下降；生活功能保持持续正相关，其增长率在强度超过10.5后略有加速；生态功能始终呈负相关，在DII为0.65时急剧下降，随后降速趋缓。综合土地功能指数在DII为6.35处达到拐点，此后其增长率逐渐减弱直至最终转为负值。本研究量化了关键功能响应阈值，拓展了LSS框架在涵盖建设用地的多功能土地系统中的适用性，有助于科学选择土地利用策略，推动国土空间开发向协调与可持续方向转型。

abstract: Using firm‐level data from emerging markets, we find that the dollar debt issuance significantly increases issuers’ risk‐taking. While the dollar debt issuance significantly increases issuers’ investment spending, it reduces their investment efficiency substantially. We also show that macroprudential policies can help mitigate the risk‐taking effect of dollar debt issuance. In addition, we provide evidence that nonissuers exhibit increased risk‐taking when faced with rising intraindustry competition pressure from issuers. Overall, the cross‐sectional risk distributions at the industry level are more tilted toward the downside.

abstract: States sometimes back rebellions abroad to signal resolve. We formally derive two interconnected predictions from the mechanism: (a) a state is more likely to endorse the uprising of a foreign group when facing a larger audience, resulting in (b) greater political inclusion for the group. title: Redemption Fees and Gates in the Lab
title_zh: 实验室中的赎回费用与限制机制
title_primary: 实验室中的赎回费用与限制机制
title_secondary: Redemption Fees and Gates in the Lab
authors: HUBERT JÁNOS KISS, ALFONSO ROSA GARCÍA, LUKAS VOELLMY
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract: We use laboratory experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of redemption fees and gates in reducing runs on funds. Our setup takes into account that investors may withdraw preemptively if they anticipate the imposition of fees or gates. We find that gates fail to reduce the propensity to run, whereas fees do have a mitigating effect on run behavior. However, the effect of fees is relatively small and takes time to materialize. Overall, our experimental results indicate that liquidity management tools are unlikely to eliminate fund fragility, consistent with the experience of the 2020 money market fund turmoil.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验室实验评估了赎回费用与赎回门槛在减少基金挤兑方面的有效性。我们的实验设计考虑了投资者若预期到费用或门槛的实施，可能会提前撤资的情况。研究发现，赎回门槛未能降低挤兑倾向，而赎回费用则对挤兑行为具有一定的缓解作用。然而，费用的影响相对较小，且需时间才能显现。总体而言，我们的实验结果表明，流动性管理工具不太可能消除基金的脆弱性，这与2020年货币市场基金动荡的经验相符。

title: Economic and Land Use Impacts of Synthetic Dairy Production on a Dairy‐Intensive Economy: New Technology Moo‐ving In
title_zh: 合成乳生产对乳业密集型经济的经济与土地利用影响：新技术悄然兴起
title_primary: 合成乳生产对乳业密集型经济的经济与土地利用影响：新技术悄然兴起
title_secondary: Economic and Land Use Impacts of Synthetic Dairy Production on a Dairy‐Intensive Economy: New Technology Moo‐ving In
authors: Niven Winchester, Dominic White
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: ABSTRACT Synthetic dairy products are promoted as an environmentally sustainable alternative to conventional dairy goods. This paper examines the potential economic, employment and land use impacts of large‐scale synthetic dairy production on Aotearoa New Zealand—the world's leading dairy exporter. Using a global, economy‐wide model, we simulate a case in which synthetic dairy products are cost‐competitive with conventional dairy products. Our results show that, under this scenario, New Zealand's GDP would decline by 0.5%–0.7%, and national welfare would fall by 1.2%–1.5%, with significant employment impacts on dairy‐related and other sectors. The reallocation of dairy land to other uses offers limited mitigation, as global shifts in production depress the prices of other agricultural commodities. Moreover, policies aimed at preserving dairy employment are costly. These findings suggest that, if synthetic dairy products are produced at scale, policy should prioritise adaptation strategies—such as retraining and skills development—to support workers and landowners in adjusting to the resulting changes.
abstract_zh: 摘要 合成乳制品被宣传为传统乳制品的一种环境可持续替代品。本文考察了大规模合成乳制品生产对新西兰——全球领先的乳制品出口国——可能产生的经济、就业和土地利用影响。利用一个全球性的经济-wide模型，我们模拟了合成乳制品与传统乳制品在成本上具有竞争力的情况。结果显示，在此情景下，新西兰的GDP将下降0.5%至0.7%，国民福利将下降1.2%至1.5%，对乳制品相关及其他部门的就业产生显著影响。将乳制品用地重新分配至其他用途所提供的缓解作用有限，因为全球生产格局的变化压低了其他农产品的价格。此外，旨在保护乳制品就业的政策成本高昂。这些发现表明，如果合成乳制品实现大规模生产，政策应优先考虑适应策略——如再培训和技能发展——以支持工人和土地所有者适应由此产生的变化。

title: Persistent monetary policy in a model with involuntary unemployment
title_zh: 非自愿失业模型中的持续性货币政策
title_primary: 非自愿失业模型中的持续性货币政策
title_secondary: Persistent monetary policy in a model with involuntary unemployment
authors: Roman Goncharenko, Elizaveta Lukmanova
abstract: In a basic New Keynesian DSGE model with involuntary unemployment, we study the role of labor markets in the transmission of persistent monetary policy shocks that increase households' inflation expectations. The model predicts that, in contrast to the standard nominal interest rate shocks, labor market conditions can affect the outcomes of persistent monetary policy shocks suggesting a trade-off between inflation and output growth: restricted labor market access leads to higher inflation response with smaller effects on output. Using a vector autoregression analysis, we further provide empirical evidence consistent with the predictions of our theoretical model.
abstract_zh: 在一个包含非自愿失业的基础新凯恩斯主义DSGE模型中，我们研究了劳动力市场在传导持续性货币政策冲击（该冲击提高家庭通胀预期）中的作用。模型预测，与标准的名义利率冲击相反，劳动力市场状况能够影响持续性货币政策冲击的结果，这表明通胀与产出增长之间存在权衡：劳动力市场准入受限导致通胀反应增强，而对产出的影响则较小。通过向量自回归分析，我们进一步提供了与理论模型预测相一致的实证证据。

title: Gender Empowerment and Climate‐Smart Agriculture: Insights and Implications for Achieving Gender Equity and Climate Resilience
title_zh: 性别赋权与气候智慧型农业：实现性别平等与气候韧性的洞见与启示
title_primary: 性别赋权与气候智慧型农业：实现性别平等与气候韧性的洞见与启示
title_secondary: Gender Empowerment and Climate‐Smart Agriculture: Insights and Implications for Achieving Gender Equity and Climate Resilience
authors: Junpeng Li, Wanglin Ma, Dil Bahadur Rahut, Ziqi Wang
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: This study investigates the effects of male and female empowerment, as well as gender empowerment inequality, on the adoption of climate‐smart agriculture (CSA) practices. Using a conditional mixed process model, we analyse survey data from 743 households across Henan, Shandong and Hebei provinces in China. The results reveal that empowering both males and females significantly promotes the adoption of CSA practices. Male and female empowerment drives the adoption of CSA practices through improving income generation and reducing agricultural production costs. Higher levels of gender empowerment inequality are linked to reduced CSA practice adoption. The positive and negative impacts of male and female empowerment, as well as gender empowerment inequality, on the adoption of CSA practices among wheat growers cultivating medium‐scale farmland are the primary focus. Additionally, empowering women and narrowing gender inequality substantially boost wheat yields, whereas male empowerment shows no significant effect. These results highlight the importance of addressing gender disparities to promote sustainable agricultural practices and ensure food security. The study advocates policies that empower rural women, reduce gender inequality in access to empowerment and foster the widespread adoption of CSA technologies, thereby advancing gender equity and climate resilience in agricultural systems.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了男性和女性赋权以及性别赋权不平等对气候智能型农业（CSA）实践采纳的影响。通过使用条件混合过程模型，我们分析了来自中国河南、山东和河北三省743户家庭的调查数据。结果显示，同时赋权男性和女性显著促进了CSA实践的采纳。男性和女性赋权通过提高收入生成和降低农业生产成本，推动了CSA实践的采纳。性别赋权不平等程度越高，与CSA实践采纳的减少相关联。男性和女性赋权的正面与负面影响，以及性别赋权不平等对中等规模农田小麦种植者采纳CSA实践的影响，是本研究的主要关注点。此外，赋权女性并缩小性别不平等显著提高了小麦产量，而男性赋权则未显示出显著效果。这些结果强调了解决性别差异以促进可持续农业实践和确保粮食安全的重要性。本研究倡导制定政策，赋权农村女性，减少获取赋权方面的性别不平等，并促进CSA技术的广泛采纳，从而在农业系统中推进性别平等和气候韧性。

title: Selling to a continuum of buyers with private values and entry costs
title_zh: 向具有私人价值和进入成本的连续买方群体销售
title_primary: 向具有私人价值和进入成本的连续买方群体销售
title_secondary: Selling to a continuum of buyers with private values and entry costs
authors: Xin Feng, Jingfeng Lu
abstract: This paper studies the revenue-maximizing selling mechanism with a continuum of buyers who have two-dimensional private information: valuation and entry cost. Using optimal control methods, we solve this two-dimensional screening problem with endogenous entry and derive sufficient conditions under which the optimal mechanism is a posted price. These conditions reduce the original problem to a one-dimensional one in which a buyer's type is net valuation, and the optimal posted price matches that of the transformed environment. Finally, under mild conditions, revenue maximization implies underselling relative to the efficient allocation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在买家拥有二维私人信息——估值与进入成本——的连续统情形下，实现收益最大化的销售机制。运用最优控制方法，我们解决了这一具有内生进入的二维筛选问题，并推导出最优机制为标价销售时的充分条件。这些条件将原始问题简化为一个一维问题，其中买家类型为净估值，且最优标价与转换后环境中的标价一致。最后，在温和条件下，收益最大化意味着相对于有效配置存在销售不足。

title: Upstreamness, foreign environmental regulation and CO2 emissions in Indian manufacturing firms
title_zh: 上游度、外国环境规制与印度制造业企业的二氧化碳排放
title_primary: 上游度、外国环境规制与印度制造业企业的二氧化碳排放
title_secondary: Upstreamness, foreign environmental regulation and CO2 emissions in Indian manufacturing firms
authors: Finn Ole Semrau
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I analyse how global value chain (GVC) position and exposure to foreign environmental regulation shape firms’ CO 2 emissions in a large emerging economy. Combining detailed energy-use records for Indian manufacturing firms with firm-specific GVC position indicators and exposure to foreign environmental policy stringency (EPS), I show three main results. A one-unit increase in upstreamness–moving further from final consumption roughly being equivalent to the average GVC position of textile firms to that of basic metals firms–raises direct CO 2 emissions by 28 % and CO 2 per unit of value added by 35 %. Second, the higher CO 2 intensity of upstream firms becomes statistically insignificant for firms that operate in industries that are highly exposed to stringent environmental regulations: the interaction term between upstreamness and EPS is negative significant and fully offsets the baseline effect. Third, exporting per se does not moderate the upstreamness-CO 2 relationship, indicating that over-proportional technology upgrading in upstream positions is driven by exposure to destination-specific factors. Overall, the evidence suggests that foreign stakeholder pressure is transmitted through GVCs and can help decarbonise energy-intensive upstream producers. • Firm-level evidence links GVC upstreamness to higher direct CO 2 intensity. • Within industries, upstream firms emit 28 % more CO 2 and 35 % more per value added. • Exposure to stringent foreign environmental regulation diminishes the higher upstreamness CO 2 intensity. • Exporting itself does not alter the upstreamness-CO 2 intensity relationship. • Cutting emissions in upstream sectors is essential for global CO 2 targets.
abstract_zh: 我分析了全球价值链（GVC）位置及对外国环境法规的暴露程度如何影响大型新兴经济体中企业的二氧化碳排放。通过将印度制造业企业的详细能源使用记录与企业特定的GVC位置指标及对外国环境政策严格性（EPS）的暴露程度相结合，我展示了三个主要结果。上游度每增加一个单位——即进一步远离最终消费，大致相当于从纺织企业的平均GVC位置转向基础金属企业的位置——直接二氧化碳排放量增加28%，单位增加值二氧化碳排放量增加35%。其次，对于处于高度暴露于严格环境法规行业的企业而言，上游企业较高的二氧化碳强度在统计上变得不显著：上游度与EPS之间的交互项为负且显著，完全抵消了基准效应。第三，出口本身并不调节上游度与二氧化碳之间的关系，这表明上游位置中不成比例的技术升级是由目的地特定因素的暴露所驱动的。总体而言，证据表明外国利益相关者的压力通过GVC传导，有助于高能耗上游生产者的脱碳。• 企业层面的证据将GVC上游度与更高的直接二氧化碳强度联系起来。• 在行业内，上游企业每单位增加值排放的二氧化碳多28%，每单位增加值排放多35%。• 暴露于严格的外国环境法规会削弱上游度带来的更高二氧化碳强度。• 出口本身并不改变上游度与二氧化碳强度之间的关系。• 削减上游部门的排放对于实现全球二氧化碳目标至关重要。

title: A nascent international financial channel of China’s monetary policy transmission
title_zh: 中国货币政策传导的新兴国际金融渠道
title_primary: 中国货币政策传导的新兴国际金融渠道
title_secondary: A nascent international financial channel of China’s monetary policy transmission
authors: Chang Ma, Alessandro Rebucci, Sili Zhou
abstract: Chinese portfolio equity outflows grew significantly over time due to capital account liberalization. Using matched stock-fund holding data under the Qualified Domestic Institutional Investor (QDII) program, we identify a nascent financial channel of international transmission of Chinese monetary policy to world stock markets. Event studies around monetary policy announcement days uncover a cross-sectional differential impact: returns on MSCI indexes and U.S. stocks with QDII exposure are more responsive than those of non-exposed ones. The effects are driven by smaller, less liquid, and lower-turnover stocks, but not by China-concept stocks, or those exposed to mainland macroeconomic shocks. We also provide evidence consistent with a retail-driven portfolio-rebalancing mechanism: tightening periods are associated with outflows from QDII funds with high equity portfolio shares that fund managers do not fully offset. Retail flows also seem more closely associated with monetary policy changes than institutional flows.
abstract_zh: 由于资本账户自由化，中国组合证券投资流出随时间显著增加。利用合格境内机构投资者（QDII）计划下的匹配股票-基金持仓数据，我们识别出中国货币政策向全球股市传导的一个新兴金融渠道。围绕货币政策公告日的事件研究发现横截面差异影响：具有QDII敞口的MSCI指数和美国股票的回报率比未暴露的股票更为敏感。这些效应由规模较小、流动性较低及换手率较低的股票驱动，而非中国概念股或受中国大陆宏观经济冲击影响的股票。我们还提供了与散户驱动的投资组合再平衡机制相一致的证据：紧缩时期与股票组合占比较高的QDII基金资金流出相关，而基金经理并未完全抵消这些流出。散户资金流动似乎也比机构资金流动与货币政策变化更为紧密相关。

title: Gender‐Sensitive Resilience in Kyrgyz Households: Latent Profile and Cross‐Lagged Dynamic Panel Approaches
title_zh: 吉尔吉斯斯坦家庭中的性别敏感韧性：潜在剖面与交叉滞后动态面板方法
title_primary: 吉尔吉斯斯坦家庭中的性别敏感韧性：潜在剖面与交叉滞后动态面板方法
title_secondary: Gender‐Sensitive Resilience in Kyrgyz Households: Latent Profile and Cross‐Lagged Dynamic Panel Approaches
authors: Bekhzod Egamberdiev, Lena Kuhn, Ihtiyor Bobojonov, Thomas Glauben
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: ABSTRACT Resilience is still conceptualised as gender‐neutral in research and policy discussions. However, a gendered resilience framework suggests that gender roles and intra‐household dynamics are intricately linked with household resilience. This manuscript aims to analyse the effect of gender role attitudes on climate change resilience. The study uses the ‘Life in Kyrgyzstan’ survey for four waves between 2012 and 2019. The estimation employs latent profile analysis (LPA) to identify homogeneous profiles based on gender role attitudes. The findings from the LPA approach produce three homogeneous clusters: ‘Low Egalitarian’, ‘Medium Egalitarian’ and ‘High Egalitarian’ profiles. The estimation strategy also incorporates the Resilience Index Measurement Analysis (RIMA) framework to construct the Resilience Capacity Index (RCI), based on four pillars: Access to Basic Services (ABS), Assets (AST), Social Safety Nets (SSN) and Adaptive Capacity (AC). To examine the potential causal relationship between gender role attitudes and resilience, the manuscript utilises a cross‐lagged panel model approach. Findings confirm that more egalitarian attitudes or moving from a ‘Low Egalitarian’ to a ‘High Egalitarian’ profile positively affect household resilience pillars, particularly through AC and SSN. The findings support the development of a policy that promotes a gendered approach to climate change resilience in Kyrgyzstan.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在研究和政策讨论中，韧性仍被视为性别中立的。然而，性别化韧性框架表明，性别角色和家庭内部动态与家庭韧性密切相关。本文旨在分析性别角色态度对气候变化韧性的影响。研究使用了2012年至2019年间四波“吉尔吉斯斯坦生活”调查数据。估计采用潜在剖面分析（LPA）来基于性别角色态度识别同质剖面。LPA方法的结果产生了三个同质聚类：“低平等主义”、“中等平等主义”和“高平等主义”剖面。估计策略还结合了韧性指数测量分析（RIMA）框架，基于四个支柱构建韧性能力指数（RCI）：基本服务获取（ABS）、资产（AST）、社会安全网（SSN）和适应能力（AC）。为考察性别角色态度与韧性之间潜在的因果关系，本文采用交叉滞后面板模型方法。研究结果证实，更平等的态度或从“低平等主义”向“高平等主义”剖面的转变对家庭韧性支柱产生积极影响，尤其是通过AC和SSN。这些发现支持在吉尔吉斯斯坦制定促进性别化气候变化韧性方法的政策。

title: Relative deprivation and financial literacy in times of economic uncertainty: exploring income satisfaction across demographic groups
title_zh: 经济不确定性时期的相对剥夺与金融素养：不同人口群体收入满意度的探究
title_primary: 经济不确定性时期的相对剥夺与金融素养：不同人口群体收入满意度的探究
title_secondary: Relative deprivation and financial literacy in times of economic uncertainty: exploring income satisfaction across demographic groups
authors: Malvika Chhatwani
abstract: We explore the association between financial literacy and income satisfaction through the framework of relative deprivation, focusing on four distinct groups characterized by gender (men versus women), race (whites versus blacks), employment status (working versus retired), and disability (non-disabled versus disabled). Utilizing nationally representative data of over six thousand participants, our ordered logistic regression analysis reveals that, even after accounting for personality traits and other demographic factors, the connection between financial literacy and income satisfaction is notably weaker among the relatively deprived segments of women, blacks, and disabled individuals which could be attributed to disparities in earning opportunities. Conversely, this relationship is more pronounced among retired individuals. Our study broadens the scope of relative deprivation theory, highlighting its relevance to well-being measures such as income satisfaction and underscores the disproportionate impact that differences in financial literacy can have on various groups due to their respective experiences of relative deprivation.
abstract_zh: 我们通过相对剥夺的框架探讨金融素养与收入满意度之间的关联，重点关注四个不同群体：性别（男性与女性）、种族（白人与黑人）、就业状态（在职与退休）以及残疾状况（非残疾与残疾）。利用超过六千名参与者的全国代表性数据，我们的有序逻辑回归分析显示，即使在考虑人格特质和其他人口统计因素后，金融素养与收入满意度之间的联系在相对被剥夺的女性、黑人和残疾群体中显著较弱，这可能归因于收入机会的差异。相反，这种关系在退休个体中更为显著。我们的研究拓宽了相对剥夺理论的适用范围，强调其与收入满意度等福祉指标的相关性，并突显了金融素养差异因各群体相对剥夺经历的不同而对不同群体产生的非对称影响。

title: Driving digital innovation in enterprises: evidence from government data openness initiatives in China
title_zh: 政府数据开放政策驱动企业数字创新的实证研究——基于中国的证据
title_primary: 政府数据开放政策驱动企业数字创新的实证研究——基于中国的证据
title_secondary: Driving digital innovation in enterprises: evidence from government data openness initiatives in China
authors: Juling Wang School of Management, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi’an, China
abstract: As digital innovation becomes a key driver of competitive advantage, enhancing organizational digital innovation has gained increasing attention. This study examines how Open Government Data (OGD) policies drive corporate digital innovation through a quasi-natural experiment based on China’s multi-phase OGD implementation. Using panel data from 2008 to 2022, we confirm OGD’s significant positive impact on corporate digital innovation. Mechanism analysis identifies three key pathways: strengthening digital infrastructure, fostering high-tech talent, and enhancing corporate digital awareness. Heterogeneity analysis shows stronger effects for non-state-owned enterprises, firms outside the Yangtze River Economic Belt, and those with higher financing constraints. The study provides theoretical and empirical insights for optimizing data governance and highlights the need for tailored policies to address firm-level disparities. Our results underscore the pivotal role of public data in digital economic growth and offer valuable guidance for maximizing OGD’s impact on corporate digital innovation.
abstract_zh: 随着数字创新成为竞争优势的关键驱动力，提升组织数字创新能力日益受到关注。本研究以中国多阶段开放政府数据（OGD）实施为自然实验，探讨OGD政策如何驱动企业数字创新。基于2008年至2022年的面板数据，我们证实了OGD对企业数字创新的显著正向影响。机制分析识别出三条关键路径：加强数字基础设施、培养高科技人才以及提升企业数字意识。异质性分析显示，非国有企业、长江经济带以外企业以及融资约束较高的企业，其影响更为显著。本研究为优化数据治理提供了理论与实证见解，并强调了针对企业层面差异制定定制化政策的必要性。我们的研究结果凸显了公共数据在数字经济增长中的关键作用，并为最大化OGD对企业数字创新的影响提供了宝贵指导。
